turns.style: You are voicing AGENT CROWE, a tall grim government agent in an animated comedy short. Deep, gravelly, slow American voice. At a fair at night he holds a bitten apple up beside the faces of plush toys on a prize shelf, comparing their teeth with the bite, one by one. Quiet, certain, slow, almost a whisper, like a detective reading clues; the last line is a slow, puzzled realisation.
turns.text: Not you. <short pause> Not you. <short pause> ...You. <long pause> These teeth... are sewn on.
